acceptanceCriteria.text: The single source for Test coverage is Implementation.tests[] ONLY. No other class's tests[] is a source; NO union read (Impl ∪ Method institutionalises two sources). Measured 0/21 legit Method-level Tests → Method.tests is never legitimate.

SCHEMA-DELETE tests[] from the 5 always-empty Loaders NOW (Requirement 0/539, UseCase 0/237, Bug 0/15, ChangeRequest 0/1, Test 0/7) — measured ZERO readers of requirement.tests (trace-audit/trace-cli repo-scan; scoreboard traverses to Impl.tests) → can't-populate by-construction. Delete from MethodLoader AFTER the migrate lands (Method holds the 21 until then).

LINT forbids a non-empty tests[] on EVERY non-Impl class (Requirement/UseCase/Method/Bug/ChangeRequest/Test): a write → RED, PLUS a lint-itself-runs bite (2-bite stub-must-fail: plant a Method.tests write → RED; weaken/remove the lint → suite RED). Delete=can't-populate + lint=can't-reintroduce, LAYERED (neither alone holds).

RETROACTIVE cleanup (coupled to the schema change by ordering): migrate the 21 Method.tests to Impl-only — DEDUP the ~13 doubles (remove the Method entry ONLY after PROVING the Impl entry is the SAME Test uuid, not name) + MIGRATE the ~8 Impl-orphans to their Impl. Preserve-FIRST (labelled snapshot before ANY mutation), dry-run with counts reported BEFORE applying, verify-owner-first per case.

The 4 MULTI-Impl misfiled (DropDispatcher.uploadFile 5 impls / Message.lazyLoadChain 6 / User.ensureRawBinUser 2 / ServiceWorker.flushAndReload) — pick the EXERCISED Impl by EVIDENCE (what the Test ASSERTS ↔ which Impl's decl/sourceFile that behaviour lives in), NEVER name-to-name (a wrong Impl = cross-wire / false credit, the C-networkFirst class). IF evidence does NOT determine it: LEAVE the Test on the Method + a NAMED lint exception for those uuids until resolved. Honest-unresolved beats plausible-placement.

NON-NEGOTIABLE ORDER: migrate FIRST, THEN switch the scoreboard read (:332 Method.tests → Impl-only). The 9 Method-only Tests are REAL coverage now; flipping the read before migration silently under-reports and complete chains present as broken. Sequence: preserve → dry-run counts → migrate → verify → switch-read → Method.tests converges empty → joins delete+lint.

INV (gate the migrate on this): distinct-Test-count across the WHOLE graph is UNCHANGED before==after the migrate — NO Test lost (conservation, same as R27.2 union INV-1b). Coverage figure UNCHANGED post-migrate: the traversal still resolves the migrated + deduped Tests. If before!=after, ABORT and restore from the preserve snapshot.
